questions.question: Whom does Joel call to lament and to consecrate a fast?
options: The kings, the princes, and the wealthy merchants of the land
The elders, the priests, and all the inhabitants of the land
The prophets, the scribes, and the judges who sit at the gate
The soldiers, the farmers, and the shepherds out in the fields
questions.answer: The elders, the priests, and all the inhabitants of the land

questions.question: Joel 1 says the day of the LORD is near, as destruction from the Almighty.
What the devouring locust left, the _____ locust has eaten.
Consecrate a fast; call a solemn _____; gather the elders.
